newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker sells stock in Aker Maritime.
newsitem.headline: Aker sells stock in Aker Maritime.

text.p: Norwegian industrial group Aker ASA said it sold five percent of its stock in Aker Maritime ASA on Wednesday, leaving it with 75 percent of shares in the offshore company.
A statement said 2.83 million shares were sold at 85 crowns per share.
Aker Maritime shares worth 241 million crowns changed hands on Wednesday on the Oslo stock exchange.

The statement said the sell-off was in line with plans for Aker to make sure that at least 30 percent of Aker Maritime shares were controlled by investors other than Aker following the merger between Aker subsidiary Aker Oil and Gas Technology and Maritime Group ASA.
